text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A letter♪ A letter♪ A l-e-t-t-e-r from 
Mom~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! The envelope smells faintly like 
milk. Could it be that another calf was 
born at the neighbor's ranch—

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"I saw the TV special! You were on it as a 
'Horse Girl to Watch', weren't ya?"

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Man oh man~ that mock race victory! 
Grandpa was truly moved. Sky really is the 
best granddaughter ever."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Aaah... Grandpa, you're exaggerating as 
usual. That was just a coincidence with 
the strategy... yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Sei-chan, are you on the phone...? 
Did my loud voice disturb you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's fine~. I just finished my 
call anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind me, please feel free to tell us 
aaall about your family love, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Sei-chan, your phone call just now 
was also brimming with family affection 
and very heartwarming.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way~ I don't possess such pure 
and innocent honesty like Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not pure and innocent either, you 
know?! It's just—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's just, um... writing a letter gives my 
honest feelings that extra little push!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's always been like that. Whenever we'd 
fight, or on Mother's Day to say thanks, 
letters make it so much easier to express 
my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And besides...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"May Spe always find happiness." Mom... 
always writes that at the very end of her 
letters.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And whenever I finish reading it... how 
should I put it, deep inside my chest 
feels so nice and warm!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Your heart feels warm, you say... Fufu, 
that is such a wonderfully sincere 
sentiment, so typical of you, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Honest feelings, huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, do you feel like writing one too, 
Sei-chan? In that case—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding★ An honest Sei-chan would be 
out of character! The fans would be 
heartbroken! So with that~. I shall take 
my leave~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Sei-chaaan?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if everyone usually sticks to 
phone calls and emails nowadays after 
all...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, rather than that~ Sei-chan is quite 
shy, so writing letters might just be a 
bit embarrassing for her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I see... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this one's cute too~♪ Ehehe... I can't 
decide which one to pick.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm picking out stylish stationery and 
envelopes! Something that'll make everyone 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Right now, I'm brainstorming an 
important plan!

Looking at her motivation-filled smile, I 
silently wished for her plan's success.
